import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Pkt {
        int x, y;

        public Pkt(int x, int y) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
        }
    }

    static class Kraw {
        int a, res;

        public Kraw(int a, int res) {
            this.a = a;
            this.res = res;
        }
    }

    static int dx[] = {-1, 0, 1, 0, 0};
    static int dy[] = {0, 1, 0, -1, 0};

    static boolean ok(int x, int y, int n) {
        return (x >= 0 && x < n && y >= 0 && y < n);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        char[][] nau = new char[n][n];
        char[][] pom = new char[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            nau[i] = st.nextToken().toCharArray();
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            pom[i] = st.nextToken().toCharArray();
        }
        int[][] odl = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                odl[i][j] = 1000;
            }
        }
        Pkt start = null;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (nau[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    start = new Pkt(i, j);
                }
            }
        }
        Queue<Pkt> q = new LinkedList<>();
        odl[start.x][start.y] = 0;
        q.add(start);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Pkt akt = q.poll();
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                Pkt nowy = new Pkt(akt.x + dx[i], akt.y + dy[i]);
                if (ok(nowy.x, nowy.y, n) && Character.isDigit(nau[nowy.x][nowy.y]) && odl[nowy.x][nowy.y] == 1000) {
                    odl[nowy.x][nowy.y] = odl[akt.x][akt.y] + 1;
                    q.add(nowy);
                }
            }
        }
        boolean[][][][][] moge = new boolean[60][10][10][10][10];
        for (int i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 10; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 10; k++) {
                    for (int l = 0; l < 10; l++) {
                        for (int m = 0; m < 10; m++) {
                            moge[i][j][k][l][m] = false;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
                    int l = i + dx[k];
                    int m = j + dy[k];
                    if (ok(l, m, n) && Character.isDigit(nau[i][j]) && Character.isDigit(nau[l][m])) {
                        moge[0][i][j][l][m] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= t - 2; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                    for (int l = 0; l < n; l++) {
                        for (int m = 0; m < n; m++) {
                            if (!moge[i][j][k][l][m]) {
                                continue;
                            }
                            for (int o = 0; o < 5; o++) {
                                int p = l + dx[o];
                                int r = m + dy[o];
                                if (ok(p, r, n) && Character.isDigit(nau[p][r]) && odl[l][m] >= i + 2 && odl[p][r] >= i + 2) {
                                    moge[i + 1][j][k][p][r] = true;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        List<Pkt> a = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(nau[i][j])) {
                    a.add(new Pkt(i, j));
                }
            }
        }
        int wie = 2 * a.size() + 2;
        List<List<Kraw>> G = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < wie; i++) {
            G.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {
            G.get(0).add(new Kraw(i + 1, Character.getNumericValue(nau[a.get(i).x][a.get(i).y])));
            G.get(i + 1).add(new Kraw(0, 0));
            G.get(a.size() + 1 + i).add(new Kraw(wie - 1, Character.getNumericValue(pom[a.get(i).x][a.get(i).y])));
            G.get(wie - 1).add(new Kraw(a.size() + 1 + i, 0));
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < a.size(); j++) {
                boolean ok = false;
                for (int k = 0; k <= t - 1; k++) {
                    ok |= moge[k][a.get(i).x][a.get(i).y][a.get(j).x][a.get(j).y];
                }
                if (ok) {
                    G.get(i + 1).add(new Kraw(a.size() + 1 + j, 1000));
                    G.get(a.size() + 1 + j).add(new Kraw(i + 1, 0));
                }
            }
        }
        int odp = 0;
        while (true) {
            boolean[] odw = new boolean[wie];
            Queue<Integer> q2 = new LinkedList<>();
            odw[0] = true;
            q2.add(0);
            int[] pop = new int[wie];
            Arrays.fill(pop, -1);
            while (!q2.isEmpty()) {
                int akt = q2.poll();
                for (Kraw kraw : G.get(akt)) {
                    if (!odw[kraw.a] && kraw.res > 0) {
                        q2.add(kraw.a);
                        pop[kraw.a] = akt;
                        odw[kraw.a] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (pop[wie - 1] == -1) {
                break;
            }
            List<Integer> path = new ArrayList<>();
            int akt = wie - 1;
            while (akt != -1) {
                path.add(akt);
                akt = pop[akt];
            }
            Collections.reverse(path);
            int flow = 1000;
            for (int i = 0; i < path.size() - 1; i++) {
                for (Kraw kraw : G.get(path.get(i))) {
                    if (kraw.a == path.get(i + 1)) {
                        flow = Math.min(flow, kraw.res);
                    }
                }
            }
            odp += flow;
            for (int i = 0; i < path.size() - 1; i++) {
                for (Kraw kraw : G.get(path.get(i))) {
                    if (kraw.a == path.get(i + 1)) {
                        kraw.res -= flow;
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int i = 1; i < path.size(); i++) {
                for (Kraw kraw : G.get(path.get(i))) {
                    if (kraw.a == path.get(i - 1)) {
                        kraw.res += flow;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        pw.println(odp);
        pw.close();
    }
}
